label: DEMO FIXTURE — NOT LIVE MODEL RESPONSE

doctor_micro.action: Activate a cancer-suspicion fast track: same-week assessment, apply national referral criteria, and order urgent imaging without waiting for a routine non-urgent slot (Kuitunen / strategy 2.5).
doctor_micro.responsible_actor: Treating GP / primary-care physician; care pathway nurse
doctor_micro.justification: Estimated primary-care interval 45.5d (benchmark 41d) in Lapland wellbeing services county with GP wait >7d at 39.5% and symptom_severity_score=7.0 on the public care track. Kuitunen's Finnish lung-cancer study attributes 41 of 155 days to primary care; delays arise from appointment access and missed symptoms.
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Compress primary-care days toward ≤41 and total pathway toward ≤155 (current estimate 172.1d).
success_metrics: Days from first contact to specialist referral
Days from referral to first diagnostic imaging
Whether national cancer-suspicion referral criteria were applied (Y/N)

doctor_micro.action: Provide structured symptom-action counselling and a written safety-net plan (when to re-contact, what red flags mean). Use plain-language, health-literacy–adapted materials (strategy 1.3).
doctor_micro.responsible_actor: Treating clinician with practice nurse / care coordinator
doctor_micro.justification: Estimated patient-attributable delay 60.5d (benchmark ~50d); age=78. County higher_education_pct=29.2%. Symptom onset reported at 60 days.
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Shorter patient delay on subsequent symptom episodes; clearer re-contact behaviour if symptoms progress.
success_metrics: Documented safety-net advice in the record
Time from safety-net trigger to re-contact
Patient-reported understanding of red flags

doctor_micro.action: Complete / document G8 frailty screening now; if G8 < 14 (or clinical frailty), refer for comprehensive geriatric assessment and include functional-capacity findings in the specialist referral (strategy 3.4).
doctor_micro.justification: Patient age=78, G8=not yet scored. Strategy 3.4 requires G8 in units treating older cancer patients and functional-capacity data already in primary-care referrals. County RAI coverage is a known regional gap.
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Treatment intensity matched to function; fewer complications from over- or under-treatment of frail patients; specialist work-up planned with geriatric input.
success_metrics: G8 score recorded before treatment decision
Geriatric assessment completed when G8 < 14 (Y/N)
Functional capacity included in referral documentation (Y/N)

doctor_micro.action: Close staging documentation gaps before MDT: complete missing clinical stage fields and ensure structured registry notification so diagnostics are not re-ordered or delayed (strategy 3.2 / quality register).
doctor_micro.justification: Missing staging fields: unspecified staging fields. Incomplete clinical notifications and imaging/report waits drive specialist delay (66.1d vs 58d benchmark). Kuitunen highlights waits for imaging, reports and samples in specialised care.
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Fewer repeat diagnostics; specialist interval closer to ≤58 days; better stage capture for early-detection monitoring.
success_metrics: Proportion of required staging fields complete at MDT
Days from referral to treatment start
Clinical cancer notification completeness for this case

doctor_micro.action: Document smoking history (pack-years / quit date) and frame this as a lung-suspicion pathway: prioritise urgent chest imaging and apply national respiratory cancer-suspicion referral criteria.
doctor_micro.justification: smoking_status=former, primary_symptom_cluster=respiratory, severity=7.0 in Lapland wellbeing services county.
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Faster imaging for high-risk respiratory presentations; clearer documentation for MDT / registry.
success_metrics: Smoking history documented (Y/N)
Days to chest imaging
Cancer-suspicion referral criteria applied (Y/N)

doctor_micro.action: Prefer local / telemedicine steps for early work-up where clinically safe; bundle imaging and specialist visits to avoid unnecessary long-distance travel.
doctor_micro.justification: travel_time_to_care_minutes=95 in Lapland wellbeing services county (>60 min threshold).
doctor_micro.expected_impact: Lower travel burden and fewer missed appointments for remote patients.
success_metrics: Share of early steps completed locally or via telemed
Missed-appointment rate

department_macro.action: Strengthen outreach and care-navigation for people aged 75+ living alone, including proactive symptom checks and social-care linkage into cancer pathways (strategy equality theme: older people; sub-objectives 3.3–3.4).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county home care / older-people services; primary healthcare
department_macro.justification: Elevated 75+ living alone (45.4%) concentrates frailty and delayed help-seeking. Strategy emphasises functional-capacity–guided care and early psychosocial / social-work support for older adults.
department_macro.expected_impact: Earlier presentation among isolated older adults; fewer late-stage diagnoses in the 75+ cohort.
success_metrics: Time from symptom onset to first contact among 75+ living alone
Share of 75+ cancer patients with a named care coordinator
Stage I–II diagnosis rate in 75+ residents

department_macro.action: Scale RAI / functional-capacity assessment coverage for 75+ and introduce the G8 screening tool in all units treating older cancer patients, feeding results into primary-care referrals (strategy sub-objective 3.4).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county geriatric and oncology services; City of Helsinki / HUS where applicable
department_macro.justification: Low 75+ RAI assessment coverage (17.3%) indicates incomplete geriatric assessment. Strategy 3.4 requires G8 screening, geriatric assessment for abnormal results, and functional-capacity data already in primary care.
department_macro.expected_impact: Treatment plans matched to frailty rather than chronological age; safer diagnostics and fewer avoidable complications in frail patients.
success_metrics: 75+ RAI assessment coverage
Share of older cancer patients screened with G8
Share of counties offering primary-care consult to a geriatric oncology team

department_macro.action: Deploy a targeted, multichannel cancer-symptom and screening awareness campaign for lower-education and linguistic-minority residents (strategy sub-objective 1.3 on health literacy).
department_macro.responsible_actor: Wellbeing services county communications & prevention; FICAN; Cancer Society of Finland
department_macro.justification: The county’s higher education share is relatively low (29.2%), which points to socioeconomic and health-literacy risk. Strategy 1.3 links limited literacy to delayed care-seeking and weaker screening participation.
department_macro.expected_impact: Fewer avoidable delays from symptom to first contact; narrower education-linked gaps in screening and outcomes.
success_metrics: Screening participation by education / mother-tongue stratum
Share of residents recognising key cancer alarm symptoms (survey)
Median patient delay from symptom onset to first contact

validated_sources: Finnish Cancer Registry (screening invitation / cancer index inputs)

evidence_classes.validated_thl_fcr: Observed county indicators and cancer_index_age_std from THL Sotkanet / Finnish Cancer Registry extracts.
evidence_classes.calibrated_projections: Model predictions, SHAP contributions, and (when present) Kuitunen-calibrated pathway day estimates.

supporting_evidence.kuitunen_source: Prof. Outi Kuitunen Finnish lung-cancer pathway study (patient 50d + primary care 41d + specialist 58d = 155d)

confidence_and_limitations.data_year_basis: Latest available county year in training table / Sotkanet extract

distinction.validated_findings: County indicators and observed cancer_index_age_std come from validated THL Sotkanet / Finnish Cancer Registry inputs in the training extract. Treat these as the evidence baseline.
distinction.calibrated_projections: Pathway day estimates and doctor_micro triage actions are calibrated projections against Prof. Outi Kuitunen's Finnish lung-cancer pathway benchmarks (50 / 41 / 58 / 155 days), not measured patient timelines.

limitations: GroupKFold CV R² can be weak; use predictions for relative prioritisation, not absolute risk labels.
SHAP explains the fitted model, not causal effects.
Patient pathway days are heuristic calibrations for triage support, not clinical orders.
National Cancer Strategy interventions are mapped from adverse SHAP families and require local validation.
